triggerCases.prompt: Address the unresolved feedback on the current pull request, but do not post replies or resolve threads.
Draft a reply to this one GitHub review comment without changing code.

outputCases.prompt: Address the valid feedback in this PR and prepare replies locally. Do not post anything.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: A feedback pass that uses a SHA-pinned CLI snapshot, rebuilds it if the PR head changes, and separates valid fixes from resolved or non-actionable feedback.
assertions: The workflow captures the base and head revisions before reading code or categorizing feedback.
The workflow fetches the ordinary PR conversation and all inline review comments before categorizing feedback, including thread-aware state when material.
The workflow refreshes PR metadata before acting and discards the snapshot if either captured boundary changed.
The workflow uses the connector for merged discussion, resolved thread state, or a CLI authentication or capability gap and does not post replies or resolve threads.
